acv.quote: About a hundred and forty K a year.

data.reason: Ines, the CFO, signed once Wen priced her manual deposit matching from her own statements. Dana first thought it was a portal deal, but the checkout pitch stalled for three weeks.

trigger.action: Lead with a slow month-end close, not online checkout.
trigger.why: A new CFO's first close took nine days. The portal Dana pitched was only the excuse.
trigger.quote: her first month-end close took nine days

decider.action: Put the finance payoff on the first page of our pitch.
decider.why: Ines read only the first page of the portal proposal and stopped there.
decider.quote: she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem

competitor.action: Offer a named person who knows her business, not lower rates.
competitor.why: Ines's bank rep had changed and the bank only offered rates. Dana never saw Fiserv's own pitch.
competitor.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.

message.action: Swap the global growth opener for matching payouts to invoices.
message.why: The standard deck got silence from a seller in three states. Wen's payout matching demo made Ines stop him.

proof.action: Add a wholesale distributor customer story to our finance messaging.
proof.why: Ines asked twice to talk to a distributor and brushed off our retail case study.
proof.quote: this is a company that sells sweaters.

words.action: Say 'where my money is' and 'deposits', not 'infrastructure'.
words.why: Ines never said payments or infrastructure. She talked about deposits and a week of archaeology.
words.quote: I just want to know where my money is.
